route: Leidimas laikinai gyventi (temporary residence permit as a performer)

permit.applies: the worker, at the Migration Department (MIGRIS), on the inviting entity's mediation letter
permit.first: a mediation letter electronically filled in and submitted by the host entity, and documents confirming the applicant is a performer

fees.what: State fee for a temporary residence permit (general order), paid on giving biometrics

permit.eligibility: documents confirming that you are a performer

sources.title: European Commission, EU Immigration Portal, Self-employed worker in Lithuania (1 April 2025); rests on the practice of the Migracijos departamentas (Migration Department under the Ministry of the Interior of Lithuania)
sources.said: If you are a sportsman, a trainer, a performer, an accredited journalist or you come to carry out governmental programmes, or you are a member of a recognised religious community, you must obtain a temporary residence permit or, if you qualify, a national long-term visa. … The decision to issue the residence permit is taken within 4 months at the latest. For an additional fee, the decision will be taken within 2 months at the latest. … the number of a mediation letter that was electronically filled in and submitted by your entity (in case you are a sportsman, a trainer, a performer or you come to carry out governmental programmes, or you are a member of a recognised religious community); a sports or employment contract (if you are a sportsman or a trainer) or documents confirming that you are a performer … Residence permits are issued for 2 years or for the period of your activities if this is less than 2 years and can be renewed each time for the same period.

sources.title: VFS Global (the Migration Department's contracted service provider), Temporary Residence Permit to Lithuania in UAE: Work
sources.said: Work Overview Visa Fees Documents Required Processing Time Download Forms --> Overview For more information about this category, please refer to the MIGRIS website https://www.migracija.lt/en/temporary-residence-permit Visa Fees Visa fees and VFS Service Fee Visa fee to be paid while submitting the biometric at the Visa Application Center. Visa fee is EUR 160 An additional VFS Service Fee of EUR 110 will be charged when you visit the Temporary Residence Permit application center.

note: The European Commission's EU Immigration Portal (Lithuania, self-employed worker, updated 1 April 2025): a performer must obtain a temporary residence permit, on a mediation letter filed by the inviting entity and documents confirming they are a performer, applied for at the Migration Department through MIGRIS; decided within four months (two months for an extra fee); issued for two years or the activity's length if shorter, renewable each time for the same period. The fees weren't found: migracija.lrv.lt and e-seimas.lrs.lt put up a bot challenge (layer 3). The EUR 160 state fee is read from the Migration Department's contracted provider (VFS Global), whose page sends readers to MIGRIS; the Department's own fee page (migracija.lrv.lt) answers 403 to this client. VFS's own EUR 110 service charge isn't a government fee and isn't held. The urgent-order fee wasn't read.
